_doc: Third-pass (2026-10-31) row entries, merged into rows.json by `tools/d3/l0_exercise.py statuses` after second-pass-statuses.json (they replace those rows' second-pass entries). Lemmas: spec/lean/v3/NearSpecV3/L0GuardSubsumption.lean. Evidence: third-pass/README.md.

L0-D2-012.reason: on allFeatures this guard runs only in checkD2CoreGWith, i.e. only for claims whose segment contains the genesis block (Successor/Config.lean `segmentHasGenesis`; every other segment goes to checkReshardCore, which decides layout changes and recomputes the split gate). It runs after the epoch-protocol-version check (`c.pv86`, L0-D2-011), so when it is reached every epoch of the claim is PV86. A segment that reaches genesis is hash-linked from the genesis block to the prev block, so it references every epoch from the genesis epoch to the witness epoch, and all of them are PV86, the genesis epoch included. nearcore requires the genesis epoch's config to be static for every genesis protocol version other than 29 (chain/epoch-manager/src/genesis.rs:63-69), so config(86) is static on such a chain: every PV86 epoch keeps the genesis layout (next_next_shard_layout, lib.rs:679-745), and no block of the segment can carry a split gate, because nearcore computes one only under a dynamic config of the applied block's epoch (chain/chain/src/runtime/mod.rs:282-298, 597; the oracle's claim.rs:174-193 builds the claim's gate by the same rule). So an honest claim never fails it; a claim that does is false and is excluded, never accepted. On mainnet (genesis PV 29) a genesis-reaching segment fails `c.pv86` first

L0-D3-003.reason: no `unmodeled` error thrown inside functionCallRecordedF reaches the catch: the non-FunctionCall throw (line 157) is dead by applyAction's `.fcall` pattern (line 302); Wasm-side `unmodeled` results are lines that lineOutcome maps to oodE before the catch; the D3.manager / distribute throws (action-log index, YR/CR shapes, printed numbers, receipt and dependency indices) are dead by the host log formats (every CR entry is pushed with a receiver, numbers are printed Nats, hex is hexStr, every receipt index is a CR/YC log index the manager has already mapped); the yield data-id throw is L0-D3-012 (dead); the yield-receipt-without-data-id throw (line 258) is dead because only yieldCreate sets `yield := true`, always with `inputs := [did]`; the finishActsGlobal re-encoding throw is L0-D3-013 (dead). Source argument (third-pass/README.md section 4), not a Lean proof

L0-D3-013.reason: the `unmodeled: global action re-encoding` exclusion is unreachable: every action encoding the manager or a raw host arm emits (CA, DC, FC, TR, ST, AF, AC, DK, DA; raw tags 5, 9, 10, 11, 12) is read back exactly by pActGlobal (gas < 2^64 by distribute, deposits u128 by getU128H, public keys validated by pkValid with pPkGlobal's sizes, account ids by validAccountId, the same rule set as AccountId.valid). Its other branch rethrows a decode error, which is not an exclusion; the one reachable instance found, a non-UTF-8 method name from promise_batch_action_add_gas_key_with_function_call, was a Lean bug (Lean accepted a nearcore-rejected chunk) and is fixed: the arm now fails with InvalidMethodName as nearcore does (receipt_manager.rs:478-508), checked on the gas-key fixture family (third-pass/README.md section 1). Source argument, not a Lean proof

L0-W-011.reason: vmCall runs only fuel-certified code (StorageExecution.lean:151); on certified code the certificate invariant holds at every state of the run (run_inv, from entry_ok/step_dec), and a state satisfying it has a frame naming a defined function at a pc inside its code (frame_ok, buildLblLive_live), so the bad-frame and pc-out-of-range arms are dead; prepare returns `.unmodeled` (excluded before the call by contractOOD) unless every gas table has the code's size, and with that (GasSized) every step finds its instruction and gas (step_lookups); the decoder builds float load/store only with load/store opcodes (Decode.lean:261-264), so their non-memory-opcode arm is dead. The compiled path is equal by @[csimp] (Arcs.lean). The other `exec` invariant arms (unmatched block/else labels, unknown function/type indices) rest on Validate.lean's typing and are argued, not proved

L0-W-014.reason: the lookup fuel 4|key|+4 exceeds the path length 2|key|+1 when every followed extension has a non-empty key: for such a trie lookup fails only with MissingTrieValue or a node-decoding error (lookup_errors). nearcore never builds an empty extension (insert_delete.rs:123-275 builds extensions from a non-empty prefix or remainder; squash.rs:29-170 only lengthens them; assumption recorded, argued from source), and SHA-256 binds the witness nodes to the root. A forged root over hand-made empty-extension chains reaches the exclusion, which never accepts. ChunkStorage.lean:77 is not imported by allFeatures
